cvm.note_on_precision: Estimate computed from wall-clock elapsed time x hourly_rate.total. Phala bills per compute-second/rounded interval per its own billing engine; the account dashboard/invoice is authoritative for exact billed amount. The CLI's /users/me and /balance-style endpoints returned 404 in this environment, so an exact starting/remaining credit figure could not be read programmatically — this is disclosed rather than guessed.
